FAQSection.title: No Questions Left
FAQSection.description: We have compiled frequently asked questions for you. If you have another question, do not hesitate to contact us.

items.question: Can I import my existing Excel data?
items.answer: Yes! With our Excel template, you can bulk upload your existing customer data, stock list, and active sales to the system. Our team supports you in this process.

items.question: How long does the installation process take?
items.answer: Novo CRM is a cloud-based system, it does not require installation. You can start using it as soon as your account is opened. Training your staff and full adaptation usually takes 1-2 business days.

items.question: How secure is our data?
items.answer: Your data is protected by 256-bit SSL encryption and automatically backed up daily. We offer a KVKK-compliant infrastructure with banking-standard security measures.

items.question: Does it require technical knowledge to use the system?
items.answer: No. Our interface is designed so that sales consultants and managers can easily use it without needing any technical knowledge.

items.question: Do you have a mobile application?
items.answer: Yes, thanks to our responsive interface compatible with all devices, you can access the system from your phone or tablet and manage your business from the field or outside the office.

items.question: Can we request a special report or feature?
items.answer: In our Enterprise package, we can make institution-specific developments and reporting. We can analyze your needs and offer you special solutions.
